feeds.title: It's Free At Last
feeds.description: My name is Kristin and I love to blog. I live in the Cincinnati, OH area & I am the mother to a wonderful teenager who is a true blessing in my life. I have been a single parent since the day she was born. I pride myself on raising her the best way I know-how. We have two great dogs and are always on the go. We live in a suburban town and love our quiet, yet active life. Its Free At Last symbolizes my liberation and freedom to explore this world and share everything I can with you.

feeds.title: Travel Inspired Living
feeds.description: I am Tonya! Wife. Mom. Empty Nester. When I am not spending time with my family, I am planning my next road trip. Whether that would be taking a day trip here in Ohio or van camping trip across the country with my husband. Here at TravelInspiredLiving.com, my goal is to provide travel inspiration for the budget-minded because I believe travel is attainable for everyone.

feeds.title: Akron Ohio Moms
feeds.description: Hi, I am Cindy. Currently, with the help of Patricia, Kristen, Amanda, Kelly, Molly, Megan, and other wonderful past writers, we share ideas, recipes, local events and experiences with products to our community. AkronOhioMoms is a hyperlocal mom blog focusing on Ohio. Product Review, Activities, local resources and ideas, PR Friendly, Recipe Creation, Photography.

feeds.title: Chasing Destino
feeds.description: I am Holley Perry, I laugh really loud. I also wear loud clothes. Writing, concerts, and photography are some of my favourites things. Also, I try to do several bucket list goals every year. I did not do anything in 2016, except for work. I am still trying to figure out how to fit Salsa and scuba diving into my schedule and budget. I have gotten over my fear of the beauty salon and bad haircuts. It has been about two years since I had boring hair.

feeds.title: Queen Thrifty
feeds.description: Queen Thrifty is a Lifestyle Travel Blogger embarking on a journey to share useful tips and stories on travel, entertainment, including celebrity interviews, recipes, and products. Her motto is 'planning ahead is the way to save' she believes we all can enjoy the best things in life even while living on a tight budget. Queen Thrifty is a Lifestyle Travel Blogger recently published in the 2019 Cleveland Citiview travel guide publication.

feeds.title: Money Savvy Living Blog
feeds.description: Money Savvy Living is designed to be a resource for money-saving ideas that affect all aspects of everyday finance and budgeting. The purpose of this site is to provide information on everything from ways to trim your grocery bill, planning a party or event with style while being able to stick to a budget, money-saving options for family vacations, creating gourmet or restaurant-style meals at home, to saving money for the future.

feeds.title: Girl About Columbus
feeds.description: Amanda, a Midwesterner in her thirties, juggles motherhood with a passion for creating beauty. As a mama to two energetic toddlers, she delights in crafting fun activities and keeps her home a haven of cosiness. When not wrangling little ones, Amanda seeks out charming destinations, cameras in tow, and enjoys exploring hidden gems. These passions all come together on her blog, Girl About Columbus, where she shares her thoughts on style, travel, family, and beauty.

feeds.title: Hall of Fame Moms
feeds.description: My name is Tracy and I have been writing from my own little corner of the globe right here at Hall of Fame Moms for over 10 years now. I write as one of many as well as for homeschooling moms who also work from home. I write as one of and for busy moms juggling more than one hat regardless of the hat. I write from our family experiences and for other family seeking answers for similar situations. Find encouraging posts, resources and tips for families. Sign up for my newsletter.

feeds.title: Midlife Mama
feeds.description: Also known as Lewis Center Mom, Midlife Mama is a north-of-Columbus, Ohio family lifestyle and travel blog started in January 2012 to document the amazing journey that is being Z's mom. This blog is an ode to midlife motherhood and only-child life. The author writes about things they love, things that bother them, and a few other things as well. They cover fun things to do in Ohio, Lewis Center life and positive, gentle and attachment parenting.

feeds.title: Deal Seeking Mom
feeds.description: I am Tara, mom of 5 teens/tweens and one 80-lb. Weimaraner, who fancies herself a lap dog. Born and raised in Ohio, my fave things include cooking & baking, my JEEP Rubicon, the 4x4 beaches at OBX, and checking out the local craft beer scene. Tara is introducing the basics of couponing to a new generation of coupon clippers through her money-saving blog, Deal Seeking Mom, teaching readers across the U.S. how to stretch their budgets in order to make room for occasional splurges. Living the good life while spending less is possible with just a little effort.

feeds.title: Just Bein' Mommy
feeds.description: Just Bein' Mommy is a family-oriented blog that reflects on building a family while being a busy mom. This blog is run by a down-to-earth mom who writes about the products and activities that enhance the experience of being a mom. Her goal is to provide information and ideas to inspire the uninspired: The families of our generation. You'll get pulled in by one post but stick around for the recipes, photography and plain old fun we have all year round.

feeds.title: The Green Eyed Lady Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Carissa and the creator of The Green Eyed Lady Blog! This blog over the years has evolved from a fashion blog into a parenting/lifestyle blog. I am still a plus size Fashionista at heart but first I am a Wife and Mom!

feeds.title: A Busy Mom of Two
feeds.description: A Busy Mom of two is a collection of money-saving opportunities and successes, tried and true recipes, thoughts on being a mom and life in general.

feeds.title: Dragonfly Sweetnest
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Amber and I live in the Buckeye State, OHIO! I was a stay at home mom for many years, however recently I went back to work as many things in my life have changed. When I am not working or doing my college (Human Resources) I spend time with my three amazing kids. Our life is full of fun family activities when it comes to the outdoors. I enjoy reviewing anything and everything. I love sharing my thoughts and opinions in hopes that it will help others when looking for something that they want more information on.

feeds.title: Cleveland East Side Moms
feeds.description: Cleveland East Side Moms is owned by Karen Horn who lives right here in the Heights! I am proud to be a member of the Local Moms Network, which was founded with the very simple goal of giving moms the gift of time. Cleveland East Side Moms wants to be the number one resource for all parents on Cleveland East Side by saving you time and energy. The site features a calendar of events, a curated resource guide, and carefully sourced discounts, all developed especially for parents located in Cleveland East Side suburbs.

feeds.title: One Momma Saving Money
feeds.description: My name is Amanda K and I run this website. I have two children, a 10-year-old daughter and 8-year-old son and I have been married to my husband for 15 years. It was the cost of baby gear that got me into couponing and saving money. I started this blog to share the coupon strategies and deals with my friends and from there it bloomed! Not only do I blog about saving money, but also product reviews, giveaways, recipes, crafts, travel and more! ! One Momma Saving Money is a blog dedicated to helping you find amazing deals and stretch your dollars. Reviews Giveaways.

feeds.title: iNeed a Playdate
feeds.description: Hello, I am Mary Johnson and I am a wife, mom, cat owner, an office manager by day and a blogger by night. I share personal stories, life as a mediocre wife and mom, events in Cleveland, the suburbs and beyond, as well as an occasional review and sweepstakes. Fueled by coffee and love, this is how I stay creative. Office manager by day, Cleveland blogger by night trying to be a mediocre wife and mom in Northeast Ohio.

feeds.title: Hyde Park Moms Blog
feeds.description: We are here to be your go-to resource for everything in & around Hyde Park Cincinnati! If you are trying to figure out what to do on any given day, looking for mommy tips or simply staying in the know, Hyde Park Moms is your one-stop-shop. Hyde Park Moms was founded with the very simple goal of saving you time and energy by providing a comprehensive collection of local events and resources, building our mommy community, and creating a safe place for mom talk. The site includes a calendar of events, a resource guide to our neighbourhoods, and general information that we find helpful to local.
